Header.value: 1. Naturalness: how natural does the voice sound, like a real person speaking? Judge only how it sounds, not whether the words are correct.

Choice.hint: Severe distortion or garbling; barely sounds like speech.
Strong artifacts or very unnatural rhythm and intonation throughout; clearly not a person.
You can tell it is not a person, but it is not unpleasant to listen to.
Small artifacts or slightly odd rhythm, noticeable only when listening closely.
Sounds like a real person speaking; no artifacts.

Header.value: 2. Intelligibility: are all the words clear and the same as in the text? Look out for words that are unclear, wrong, missing, added or repeated, or cut off.

Choice.hint: Most of the text is wrong or missing, it is a different sentence or a different language, or no words can be made out.
Many words are unclear, wrong, missing or repeated, or a part of the text is skipped or cut off. You cannot follow the sentence without reading the text.
Some words are unclear, wrong, missing, added or repeated, but you can still follow the sentence.
Nearly everything is clear and as in the text. There is a small problem that hardly gets in the way.
All words are clear and exactly the words in the text. Nothing is missing, added or changed.
